## Hands-on 4 – The submission {#hands-on-4-the-submission .smaller .output-8}

::: {.small}
`my_experiments()` lists your tries. Rerun the one that you would defend and **submit it**: the cell prints your tag and the address of the form, and your circle appears on the [Class results]({{< var cases.housing.live-results-url >}}) page. *IDE:* the chunks `my-experiments` and `submit-exploration`.
:::

```{webr}
#| autorun: false
my_experiments()
```

```{webr}
#| autorun: false
submit_exploration()
```

::: notes
When you have three or four tries, print the log. My underscore experiments lists the tries side by side, with only the decisions that you varied, which is the small multiverse that you have just built. Rerun the try for which you can argue best, so that it is your last, and submit it. The cell prints your submission line, the address of a form with every field filled in, and a tag, which marks your circle on the class chart. Open the address in a new tab and press Send, and the circle appears on the Class results page within seconds, open because the result is exploratory. If you choose your own tag, use a nickname rather than your name, because the chart is public. The preregistered analysis comes in Task 5. [wait for the circles; then read the chart]
:::
